mapping.summary: Multi-store WooCommerce connector: catalogue publishing, order import, payments, refunds and tracking write-back.
claims: Several WooCommerce stores per BC company, each with own settings
BC is catalogue master; WooCommerce is the order source
Direct HTTPS calls with no middleware
Publishes items with SKUs, attributes, categories, weights and dimensions
Variants become WooCommerce variations with own price and stock
Uploads item pictures to the product gallery
Queued price and stock updates with hourly price reconciliation
Stock calculated for a chosen location
Guided migration of an existing WooCommerce catalogue into BC
Orders staged for review and deduplicated
Shipping, coupon and fee lines mapped to G/L accounts
Unpaid orders held until paid, with override for pay-in-store
Manual, auto-release or auto ship-and-invoice fulfilment modes
Customers matched by email or WooCommerce ID; guests to a guest customer
Refunds both ways: imported as credit memos, posted credit memos sent back
Carrier and tracking number written back on shipment posting
Maps tax classes to VAT product posting groups
SKU matching by item number, item plus variant, or barcode
Role center with revenue, return rate, top sellers and failed-sync tiles
Automatic retry honouring Retry-After
Credentials in isolated storage
